records.text: Owens said Lyle Reams's prior indictment apparently did not prevent Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta from forming Desert Spirit Tek with Lyle and Shelly Reams in 2017.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyways, this background I'm telling you about Lyle (Lyle Reams) because it was apparently not a bar to entry for Lori (Lori Frantzve) and Larry (Larry Guinta) to pursue a business with Lyle (Lyle Reams) because fast forward to 2017 and together they filed to open a business. ... verification.notes: Arizona Corporation Commission articles and the current entity index identify Desert Spirit Tek LLC, its 2017 formation, and members Lorin Frantzve, Lawrence Guinta, Lyle Reams, and Shelly Reams. This matches the transcript claim, allowing for the filing spelling Lorin.

records.text: The gun patent that interested Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta is now approved and covers a weapon with interchangeable calibers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Similarly, Lori Frantzve and Larry were interested in a gun pending patent, and this was going to be a gun that was and is today the only now patent approved weapon that features interchangeable calibers.

verification.notes: Transcript context combines an unidentified recently granted patent claim with an exclusivity claim. Public patent records confirm multi-caliber cylinder firearms and chamber rifling were patented decades earlier, directly undermining the assertion that this is the only approved weapon of that kind; the specific patent allegedly discussed with Frantzve and Guinta could not be identified or confirmed.

sources.title: US3173221A - Revolver cylinders for multiple calibers
sources.relevance: A granted 1965 patent directly documents a revolver cylinder accommodating cartridges of different calibers, contradicting the exclusivity portion of the statement.

sources.title: US3050894A - Rotatably adjustable firing pin for center or rim fire cartridges
sources.relevance: The patent describes a two-caliber cylinder with rifled cartridge chambers, further showing that the claimed features are not unique to a newly approved patent.
